semantic_evidence.original_quote: List the CRs whose affected clauses resolve to actual sections of spec 38.331 (clause-to-section matching).
query_clauses:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected) <> ''
MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(target:Release)
MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
WHERE rk.specRelease = target.releaseName
WITH DISTINCT cr, rk
MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(rk)
WHERE cr.clausesAffected CONTAINS s.sectionNumber
WITH cr, s
WHERE (
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '[0-9]+|[A-Z]' AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?:^|[,;\\n&]|\\band\\b)\\s*(?:(?i:sub-?clauses?|clauses?|sections?|annex(?:es)?)\\s+)?\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E\\.?\\s*(?:\\([^)]*\\)\\s*)?(?:$|[,;\\n&]|\\band\\b).*'))
    OR
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '([0-9].*|[A-Z]\\..*)' AND NOT s.sectionNumber =~ '[0-9]+'
      AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?<![A-Za-z0-9._/#:~\\-])\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E(?![A-Za-z0-9_]|\\.[A-Za-z0-9]).*'))
    OR
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9-]+' AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?:^|[,;\\n&])\\s*(?:[0-9][A-Za-z0-9.]*\\s*[–\\-:(/]\\s*)?\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E\\s*\\)?\\s*(?:$|[,;\\n&]).*'))
  )
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
ORDER BY tdocNumber

rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): links a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node (specNumber, release) to its ABSTRACT HUB Spec node (specNumber only). Functional: each release-keyed Spec belongs to exactly one hub. Lets release-blind references resolve to the hub while Sections attach to the release-keyed parent; release-blind aggregation CQs traverse hub ← inReleaseOf ← release-keyed → Section. rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): links a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node (specNumber, release) to its ABSTRACT HUB Spec node (specNumber only). Functional: each release-keyed Spec belongs to exactly one hub. Lets release-blind references resolve to the hub while Sections attach to the release-keyed parent; release-blind aggregation CQs traverse hub ← inReleaseOf ← release-keyed → Section. Neo4j relation type IN_RELEASE_OF."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): inverse of tdoc:inReleaseOf — an ABSTRACT HUB Spec node to its RELEASE-KEYED variants (one per release present in the corpus). 0..* (a spec lacking a frozen final for some release has no variant there)."@en ;

rdfs:comment "Section number from heading (e.g., 5.1.3.2, A.1, 8.1.4A). Body: ^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)*[a-zA-Z]?$, Annex: ^[A-Z](\\.[0-9]+)*$"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Section title text from heading (excluding sectionNumber)"@en ;

rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): links a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node (specNumber, release) to its ABSTRACT HUB Spec node (specNumber only). Functional: each release-keyed Spec belongs to exactly one hub. Lets release-blind references resolve to the hub while Sections attach to the release-keyed parent; release-blind aggregation CQs traverse hub ← inReleaseOf ← release-keyed → Section. Neo4j relation type IN_RELEASE_OF."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): inverse of tdoc:inReleaseOf — an ABSTRACT HUB Spec node to its RELEASE-KEYED variants (one per release present in the corpus). 0..* (a spec lacking a frozen final for some release has no variant there)."@en ;

rdfs:comment "Section title text from heading (excluding sectionNumber)"@en ;

rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): links a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node (specNumber, release) to its ABSTRACT HUB Spec node (specNumber only). Functional: each release-keyed Spec belongs to exactly one hub. Lets release-blind references resolve to the hub while Sections attach to the release-keyed parent; release-blind aggregation CQs traverse hub ← inReleaseOf ← release-keyed → Section. Neo4j relation type IN_RELEASE_OF."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): inverse of tdoc:inReleaseOf — an ABSTRACT HUB Spec node to its RELEASE-KEYED variants (one per release present in the corpus). 0..* (a spec lacking a frozen final for some release has no variant there)."@en ;

rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): links a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node (specNumber, release) to its ABSTRACT HUB Spec node (specNumber only). Functional: each release-keyed Spec belongs to exactly one hub. Lets release-blind references resolve to the hub while Sections attach to the release-keyed parent; release-blind aggregation CQs traverse hub ← inReleaseOf ← release-keyed → Section. Neo4j relation type IN_RELEASE_OF."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): inverse of tdoc:inReleaseOf — an ABSTRACT HUB Spec node to its RELEASE-KEYED variants (one per release present in the corpus). 0..* (a spec lacking a frozen final for some release has no variant there)."@en ;

rdfs:comment "Section number from heading (e.g., 5.1.3.2, A.1, 8.1.4A). Body: ^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)*[a-zA-Z]?$, Annex: ^[A-Z](\\.[0-9]+)*$"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Section title text from heading (excluding sectionNumber)"@en ;

rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): links a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node (specNumber, release) to its ABSTRACT HUB Spec node (specNumber only). Functional: each release-keyed Spec belongs to exactly one hub. Lets release-blind references resolve to the hub while Sections attach to the release-keyed parent; release-blind aggregation CQs traverse hub ← inReleaseOf ← release-keyed → Section. Neo4j relation type IN_RELEASE_OF."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): inverse of tdoc:inReleaseOf — an ABSTRACT HUB Spec node to its RELEASE-KEYED variants (one per release present in the corpus). 0..* (a spec lacking a frozen final for some release has no variant there)."@en ;

rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): links a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node (specNumber, release) to its ABSTRACT HUB Spec node (specNumber only). Functional: each release-keyed Spec belongs to exactly one hub. Lets release-blind references resolve to the hub while Sections attach to the release-keyed parent; release-blind aggregation CQs traverse hub ← inReleaseOf ← release-keyed → Section. Neo4j relation type IN_RELEASE_OF."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): inverse of tdoc:inReleaseOf — an ABSTRACT HUB Spec node to its RELEASE-KEYED variants (one per release present in the corpus). 0..* (a spec lacking a frozen final for some release has no variant there)."@en ;

actual_lines.text: rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): the 3GPP Release a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node represents. Present only on release-keyed Spec nodes (one (specNumber, release) pair → one Release); ABSTRACT HUB Spec nodes have none. Parallels tdoc:targetRelease (which targets Tdoc/TechnicalReport)."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): links a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node (specNumber, release) to its ABSTRACT HUB Spec node (specNumber only). Functional: each release-keyed Spec belongs to exactly one hub. Lets release-blind references resolve to the hub while Sections attach to the release-keyed parent; release-blind aggregation CQs traverse hub ← inReleaseOf ← release-keyed → Section. question_en: List CRs on spec 38.133 that touch clause 4.2 (clause-level change filter).
reference_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
  AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected) <> ''
WITH DISTINCT cr, trim(cr.clausesAffected) AS declaredField
WITH cr, declaredField,
     reduce(normalized = toLower(declaredField), token IN ['sections', 'section', 'clauses', 'clause', 'through', 'to', '~', '–', '—'] |
       replace(normalized, token, CASE WHEN token IN ['through', 'to', '~', '–', '—'] THEN '-' ELSE '' END)) AS chapterRange
WHERE declaredField =~ '(?s).*(?<![A-Za-z0-9.])4\\.2(?:\\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*(?![A-Za-z0-9]|\\.[A-Za-z0-9]).*'
   OR (declaredField =~ '(?is)\\s*(?:sections?|clauses?)\\s+[0-9]+\\s*(?:~|-|–|—|to|through)\\s*[0-9]+\\s*'
       AND toInteger(trim(split(chapterRange, '-')[0])) <= 4
       AND toInteger(trim(split(chapterRange, '-')[1])) >= 4)
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
ORDER BY tdocNumber

actual_lines.text: rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): the 3GPP Release a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node represents. Present only on release-keyed Spec nodes (one (specNumber, release) pair → one Release); ABSTRACT HUB Spec nodes have none. Parallels tdoc:targetRelease (which targets Tdoc/TechnicalReport)."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): links a RELEASE-KEYED Spec node (specNumber, release) to its ABSTRACT HUB Spec node (specNumber only). Functional: each release-keyed Spec belongs to exactly one hub. Lets release-blind references resolve to the hub while Sections attach to the release-keyed parent; release-blind aggregation CQs traverse hub ← inReleaseOf ← release-keyed → Section. Neo4j relation type IN_RELEASE_OF."@en ;

rdfs:comment "v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid): inverse of tdoc:inReleaseOf — an ABSTRACT HUB Spec node to its RELEASE-KEYED variants (one per release present in the corpus). 0..* (a spec lacking a frozen final for some release has no variant there)."@en ;

RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber

actual_lines.text: rdfs:comment "3GPP Technical Document - base class for all meeting documents"@en .
rdfs:comment "Change Request document that modifies a 3GPP specification (TS/TR). Includes CR, draftCR, and pCR types."@en .

rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .
rdfs:comment "Specification(s) that this CR modifies. Cardinality 1..*: a single CR may amend more than one Spec (e.g., paired stage-2 and stage-3 updates)."@en ;
rdfs:comment "Direct child Section(s) of this Section"@en ;
tdoc:parentSection a owl:ObjectProperty, owl:FunctionalProperty, owl:IrreflexiveProperty, owl:AsymmetricProperty ;
rdfs:comment "Direct parent Section (exactly one, null for level-1)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Specification clauses affected by this CR (e.g., '5.3.1, 5.3.2')"@en ;
| 3-1 | 특정 CR이 수정한 TS는? | CR → Spec |
| 3-2 | 특정 CR이 수정한 TS의 Section 구조는? | CR → Spec → Section |
| 3-3 | 특정 TS를 수정한 CR 목록은? | Spec ← CR |
| 3-4 | 특정 Section을 수정한 CR 목록은? | clausesAffected 기반 * |
| 3-5 | 특정 Work Item 관련 CR이 수정한 TS 목록은? | WorkItem → CR → Spec |
| 3-6 | 특정 회사가 수정한 TS 목록은? | Company → CR → Spec |
*CQ 3-4 제약사항: clausesAffected 있는 CR만 (Appendix A [P3-V05] 참조)*
| hasSubSection | Irreflexive | Section이 자기 자신의 하위가 될 수 없음 |
| hasSubSection | Asymmetric | A가 B의 부모면 B는 A의 부모가 아님 |
| parentSection | Irreflexive | Section이 자기 자신의 상위가 될 수 없음 |
| parentSection | Asymmetric | A가 B의 자식이면 B는 A의 자식이 아님 |
| referencesSection | Irreflexive | Section이 자기 자신을 참조하는 것은 무의미 |
| referencesSection | NOT Asymmetric | 두 Section이 서로 참조 가능 (상호 참조) |
| hasSubSection | NOT Transitive | 직접 하위만 연결 (손자는 체인으로) |

actual_lines.text: rdfs:comment "3GPP Technical Document - base class for all meeting documents"@en .
rdfs:comment "Change Request document that modifies a 3GPP specification (TS/TR). Includes CR, draftCR, and pCR types."@en .

rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .
rdfs:comment "Specification(s) that this CR modifies. Cardinality 1..*: a single CR may amend more than one Spec (e.g., paired stage-2 and stage-3 updates)."@en ;
rdfs:comment "Direct child Section(s) of this Section"@en ;
tdoc:parentSection a owl:ObjectProperty, owl:FunctionalProperty, owl:IrreflexiveProperty, owl:AsymmetricProperty ;
rdfs:comment "Direct parent Section (exactly one, null for level-1)"@en ;
rdfs:comment "Specification clauses affected by this CR (e.g., '5.3.1, 5.3.2')"@en ;
| 3-1 | 특정 CR이 수정한 TS는? | CR → Spec |
| 3-2 | 특정 CR이 수정한 TS의 Section 구조는? | CR → Spec → Section |
| 3-3 | 특정 TS를 수정한 CR 목록은? | Spec ← CR |
| 3-4 | 특정 Section을 수정한 CR 목록은? | clausesAffected 기반 * |
| 3-5 | 특정 Work Item 관련 CR이 수정한 TS 목록은? | WorkItem → CR → Spec |
| 3-6 | 특정 회사가 수정한 TS 목록은? | Company → CR → Spec |
*CQ 3-4 제약사항: clausesAffected 있는 CR만 (Appendix A [P3-V05] 참조)*
| hasSubSection | Irreflexive | Section이 자기 자신의 하위가 될 수 없음 |
| hasSubSection | Asymmetric | A가 B의 부모면 B는 A의 부모가 아님 |
| parentSection | Irreflexive | Section이 자기 자신의 상위가 될 수 없음 |
| parentSection | Asymmetric | A가 B의 자식이면 B는 A의 자식이 아님 |
| referencesSection | Irreflexive | Section이 자기 자신을 참조하는 것은 무의미 |
| referencesSection | NOT Asymmetric | 두 Section이 서로 참조 가능 (상호 참조) |
| hasSubSection | NOT Transitive | 직접 하위만 연결 (손자는 체인으로) |
